title: A go-ahead committed as a substantive prompt
story: B2 was a go-ahead: she typed `looks good`. A modified client commits its f.pc as substantive. Its low_effort, lengths, sketch, template and commitment are honest. pkg/score derives a prompt's class from the body's low_effort, answers_question and typed_len_est, never from f.pc, so the forged class alone changes no credit. B2 is drawn, and the class SM 2.2 gives its revealed text is low_effort.
edits: The transcript's user entry for each prompt, read by the log reader 0.7 to 4.5 s after the hook (via log, same turn_key and lengths), as a real Claude Code client records it.
B2's text is 'looks good': its hook record and the transcript's copy have len_chars and typed_len_est 10, and low_effort true, SM 2.2's go-ahead test of the text.
She types it in the slot before B2: the key presses from 19:41:15 to 19:41:44 are gone, and the typing module counts 11 key-downs, the ten characters and Enter, in the slot from 19:41:45.
B2's f holds the honest sketch and template of its text, and class substantive.

CC5.basis: one device, whose scorer credits each slot to at most one project (SM 3.1)

CC6.basis: Stated, not recomputed: the live buckets are pkg/score over this device's events.jsonl, which the reveal holds in full, so the server's re-score is the same computation and every minute reproduces.

CC10.reason: no editor act in the submission

notes: `looks good` is on SM 2.2's go-ahead list, and no agent output before B2 asks a question, so its class is low_effort whatever its length. pkg/score derives that class from the body's low_effort, answers_question and typed_len_est (classify in pkg/score/turns.go) and never reads f.pc, so the live client and the re-score both credit B2 as a go-ahead and CC6 passes. Only CC8 sees the forged f.pc (`class`).
A go-ahead's lead has no typing part (SM 2.3), so CC11 counts the other four prompts and not B2.
B2 is still human_typed (SM 2.2 rule 6): a key press in the 10 s before it, focus on the terminal, and 10 characters in one input slot. It isn't a re-roll of B1, and A3 is still the third A.
DESIGN 7.3 and ledger-v1.md 10.8, as issue #15's decision rewrote them: CC8 reveals no keyed value and checks only what needs no key
